gate: RTK C9 HMT lambda=1 S3 ell=1 zero-mode gauge classification
scope: Classify the ell=1 kernel of the previously frozen S3 constant-curvature second-class block using exact S3 scalar-harmonic geometry and the spatial-diffeomorphism action on the metric.
required_checks: For ell=1, derive the S3 Hessian identity nabla_i nabla_j Y_1=-(1/a^2) g_ij Y_1.
Construct xi_i=-(a^2/2) nabla_i f for an ell=1 scalar f and verify delta_xi g_ij=f g_ij.
Verify that the conformal ell=1 perturbation that gives C12=0 is therefore a spatial-diffeomorphism gauge direction on the frozen background.

Verify dimension counting: scalar ell=1 harmonics on S3 form a four-dimensional space, matching the four gradient conformal-Killing directions, without claiming these exhaust all S3 Killing/conformal-Killing vectors.
Keep ell=0 and ell>=2 nonzero-rank conclusions from the parent scoped result unchanged.
Do not claim the full Faddeev-Senjanovic determinant is computed unless the complete gauge-fixed HMT constraint matrix and zero-mode quotient are explicitly constructed.
Do not claim full HMT one-loop evaluability or close full C9.
Do not import ordinary projectable-Horava beta functions, choose unresolved HMT matter-interface coefficients, change frozen thresholds, allow soft-s retest, or unblock k=0.03 production.
pass_condition: Exact symbolic identities establish that every scalar ell=1 zero mode of this frozen conformal block is tangent to a spatial-diffeomorphism orbit on round S3; classification remains scoped and no full determinant/C9 closure is claimed.
fail_condition: The ell=1 conformal perturbation cannot be generated by a spatial diffeomorphism under the frozen conventions, or any required exact identity fails.
